MathParkourBuffItem.1.2: Grants Sparkla a small burst of Speed upon pickup.
MathParkourBuffItem.2.2: When hitting an obstacle, Sparkla doubles the Speed the obstacle consumes while her own consumption remains the same. Lasts 15s.
MathParkourBuffItem.3.2: Hitting an obstacle also hits obstacles in adjacent lanes. Lasts 15s.
MathParkourBuffItem.4.2: When Sparkla hits an obstacle, Super Action Pie knocks it away and destroys it. Triggers only once per pickup. Lasts 8s.
MathParkourBuffItem.5.2: Amber assists Sparkla by firing a steady stream of bullets forward, reducing the Speed of any obstacles they hit. Lasts 8s.
MathParkourBuffItem.6.2: Noya assists Sparkla by firing Sword Auras at random obstacles, reducing their Speed. Noya unleashes a stronger Sword Aura right before the effect ends. Lasts 8s.
MathParkourBuffItem.7.2: Iris assists Sparkla by casting Glacier Array, continuously reducing the Speed of obstacles within range. A massive ice block drops right before the effect ends. Lasts 5s.
MathParkourBuffItem.8.2: Press the button to activate the Omni Suppressor. Once active, Rabbit Pie throws a powerful bomb that clears all obstacles ahead. If not activated manually, it automatically triggers after 5s.
